intent: Bring shell_check.sh under the 250-line cap by moving its nine functions into three sourced libs, leaving discovery and linting behaviour unchanged.
scope: Non-goal: fixing --skip-install, which does not gate the AUR install path
Non-goal: changing the file's 2-space indentation style
changes: Moved is_cmd, is_arch, have_aur_helper, install_if_missing and install_linters into lib/shell_check_install.sh.
Moved discover_shell_files and print_file_list into lib/shell_check_discover.sh.
Moved run_linters, the 163-line body holding the shellcheck, shfmt, checkbashisms, bashate and per-dialect syntax passes, into lib/shell_check_lint.sh.

The entry keeps the header, common.sh source, option defaults, usage, argument parsing, the mktemp -d with its EXIT trap, the ABS_FILES_Z / REL_FILES_Z paths, and the main dispatch. The three libs are sourced after the options and paths they read.
The temp-file paths are set once in the entry before any lib is sourced and are only read thereafter, so no mutable state crosses a file boundary.

verification.evidence: Zero findings across all four files at the repo's no-severity-filter setting, on the first attempt, with no suppression added.

verification.command: bash -n on the entry and each lib

verification.evidence: entry 121, lint 171, install 86, discover 78. None of the four appears in the violation list.

verification.command: bash scripts/meta/shell_check.sh --skip-install --list-only --verbose, diffed against the same run from a detached worktree at HEAD
verification.evidence: 318 files at HEAD, 321 now. The delta is exactly the three new lib files, which the discovery walk correctly picks up as shell scripts; nothing was removed and no other path changed. An earlier version of this check used a grep that matched nothing and silently compared two empty lists -- it needed --verbose, since print_file_list only enumerates in verbose mode.

Identical: all nine functions preserved (discover_shell_files, have_aur_helper, install_if_missing, install_linters, is_arch, is_cmd, print_file_list, run_linters, usage), each defined exactly once across the four files.

verification.command: sorted line-set diff of HEAD:shell_check.sh against entry+libs concatenated
verification.evidence: Zero lines lost. The only additions are the three source lines.

risks: The linting path itself was not executed. run_linters cannot be exercised without the install path running first, and --skip-install does not gate the AUR branch: a full run during this session began installing python-bashate and pulled in python-pbr, python-fixtures, python-discover and python-reno before it was killed. The user chose to leave those four installed. Verification is therefore static plus the --list-only runtime path, which does exercise every source line and the discovery function.

Because run_linters was moved as one intact 163-line block with no interior edit, and the line-set diff proves nothing was lost or reordered, the risk of a behavioural change inside it is confined to the seam at its boundaries, both of which are function braces.

CI invokes this script as `bash scripts/meta/shell_check.sh --skip-install` from linux_configuration/.github/workflows/shell-check.yml. The entry keeps its path and its ${BASH_SOURCE[0]}-based SCRIPT_DIR, so the libs resolve there the same way they do locally.
rollback: git revert the commit; shell_check.sh returns to its 428-line single-file form and the three libs disappear.
After rollback, re-run bash scripts/meta/shell_check.sh --skip-install --list-only --verbose and confirm it discovers 318 files again.
